description: This PHP source file defines a class tracxmlrpcInterface which extends issueTrackerInterface, providing an implementation for interfacing with a Trac-based issue tracker via XML-RPC. The class includes methods for configuration, connection management, fetching issue details, and communication with the server.

classes.name: tracxmlrpcInterface
classes.description: A class that facilitates communication with a Trac issue tracking system via XML-RPC, allowing retrieval and management of issues.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration URLs with default paths if not set.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client object used for XML-RPC communication.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks whether the given bug ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Trac XML-RPC server by creating an API client.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the system is currently connected to the server.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves issue details for a given issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code for a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of an issue; currently delegates to getIssueStatusCode.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML-formatted summary string of an issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a bug with the specified ID exists.

methods.name: createAPIClient
methods.description: Creates and configures the XML-RPC client for server communication.

methods.name: sendCmd
methods.description: Sends an XML-RPC command to the server with specified parameters.
